verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 28 West 53rd Street in midtown Manhattan.
verified_facts.excerpt: 28 West 53rd Street

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located in the center of midtown Manhattan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the center of midtown Manhattan, Baccarat Hotel is the perfect home base for all your urban adventures.

verified_facts.text: Spa de La Mer is the first dedicated La Mer spa in the United States.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa de La Mer is the first dedicated La Mer spa in the United States, offering bespoke treatments designed to restore radiance and bring the senses back into balance.

verified_facts.text: La Piscine, the hotel's heated indoor pool, sits beneath a barrel-vaulted ceiling with Riviera-inspired cabanas, white daybeds and a checkerboard floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beneath a dramatic barrel-vaulted ceiling, La Piscine offers a luminous retreat in the heart of the city. Heated waters, Riviera-inspired cabanas, and white daybeds invite moments of relaxation

verified_facts.text: La Piscine has a checkerboard floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: the iconic checkerboard floor brings a touch of playful elegance

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms come with Baccarat crystal stemware.
verified_facts.excerpt: Baccarat Crystal Stemware

verified_facts.text: Rooms have linen by Somma 1867.
verified_facts.excerpt: Linen by Somma 1867

verified_facts.text: Rooms have twice daily housekeeping service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Twice Daily Housekeeping Service

verified_facts.text: Suite stays include a dedicated Attache who shapes the experience before arrival and throughout the stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every suite stay is designed by a dedicated Attaché who’ll shape your experience before arrival and throughout your stay.

verified_facts.text: Signature Suites offer accommodations for up to seven guests with separate living spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expansive accommodations for up to seven guests,  separate living spaces, remarkable views, and a dedicated Attaché

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have rooms with a balcony or terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt:
### Do you have rooms with a balcony or terrace?

No, we do not.

verified_facts.text: Guests can use the hotel's Maybach house car for rides anywhere within 15 blocks of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxury house car service in our Maybach is available to guests for à propos jaunts through Manhattan—anywhere within 15 blocks of the hotel.

verified_facts.text: A curated collection of contemporary artworks and Baccarat creations is displayed throughout the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Throughout the hotel, a thoughtfully curated collection of contemporary artworks and Baccarat creations reflects the Maison’s enduring dialogue between art, craftsmanship, and design.

verified_facts.text: The 53rd Street Boutique inside the hotel sells Baccarat creations and offers private shopping appointments on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located within the hotel, the boutique also offers private shopping appointments upon request.

verified_facts.text: Dogs are welcomed with dedicated amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dogs are welcomed with the same warmth and attention extended to every guest, complete with thoughtful amenities designed to make them feel right at home.

verified_facts.text: The fitness room has Technogym and Woodway equipment, a separate room for yoga and Pilates, and is open 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Also containing a separate freestyle room for yoga and Pilates, the space is continually replenished with amenities and is open 24 hours.

verified_facts.text: Dining at the hotel includes the Grand Salon, The Bar and Afternoon Tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Come for Afternoon Tea. Stay for dinner and cocktails.

verified_facts.text: The Salon Prive offer is a behind-the-scenes exploration of contemporary art galleries and private studios reserved for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience an intimate, behind-the-scenes exploration of New York’s most prestigious contemporary art galleries and private studios, reserved exclusively for Baccarat Hotel New York guests.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature contemporary interiors with French influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Contemporary interiors, French influences, and moments of calm create a stay that feels distinctly Baccarat.

verified_facts.text: Room categories feature floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor to Ceiling Windows
